Reference

Fantomon ability trees

Three trees, one per Fantomon role, shown for the Mythic Fantomon. Each has ten pages of nodes drawn the way the game lays them out, and every node has ten levels. The table gives, for each page, what it costs to fill, what that is worth in power, and what a full page grants. Epic and Legendary Fantomon use the same tree with smaller numbers, stated under each table.

Materials and power

Each role pays in its own family, and within a family four of a tier merge into one of the next (item_merge): 4 × 1 → 1 · 4 × 1 → 1 · 4 × 1 → 1 · 4 × 1 → 1 · 4 × 1 → 1 · 4 × 1 → 1. Wool, Egg and Essence do not convert into each other; the only way across is the self-choose material boxes.

Show costs sixteen of the base make one of the top tier; the top-tier figure is not rounded

The game scores stats with fixed weights (prop_cfg): ATK and DEF 2.5 per point, SPD 3.125, HP 0.5. A node's percent bonus multiplies the Fantomon's own stat, so its worth depends on the Fantomon's level; the table shows the flat part and the total for a Fantomon at level 100, 150, 200. Pages open in order and some need a promotion: page 2 at Expert I, 4 at Champion I, 6 at Master I, 8 at Paragon I, 9 at Saint I. Every node's stats are scaled by the Fantomon's quality (pet_ability_prop_scale_factor): Mythic +20%, Legendary +10%, Epic none.

Purrwikimania — an independent, fan-made reference for Sword x Staff (Boltray Games). Every number here is read directly out of the game's own configuration files and decompiled code, not from testing or estimation. Item names are the game's official English strings.

Not affiliated with or endorsed by Boltray Games. Game names, images and data are the property of their owners. Figures reflect the client build they were extracted from and can change with any patch — see Method for exactly what was read and when.
